games.name: Possessor
games.desc:
Of Crescents and Dreamscapes Update - LIVE NOW

Someone around you is not who they seem, socialize with the people around you to determine who is real and who is possessed. 

Every round one of you will be selected as the possessor, they can take over other bodies and will try to impersonate those around them. Look for clues in the way they talk to determine who you think it is, be careful as the real possessor may be who you least expect it to.

🔥 Use abilities from the shop to scare and confuse those around you
🐈‍⬛ Thumbs up the game if you enjoy!
🦴 Join the group to support us
🎵 Music is all non copyright and can be used in videos

This game is best played with friends, just remember not to reveal anything when you die! Current game is in a very early state we will act quickly on any suggestions or feedback provided.

games.name: ARCHEMARA [EARLY ACCESS]
games.desc:
Archemara is a combat-intensive co-op PVE dungeon crawler.

Archemara is currently in Early Access, your patience with any encountered bug or inconvenience is greatly appreciated!

MAIN CONTROLS
X - Draw & holster
F - Healing flask
Tab - Index Menu & close menus
M1 - Primary moveset
M1 + Shift - Secondary moveset
M1 + Ctrl - Tertiary moveset
M2 - Block & Parry
MMB - Target lock-on
Space - Dodge

All roadmaps, patch notes, & discussions are held in the Battle Core Games server.
Our community: https://www.roblox.com/share/g/32941830

Developed under Battle Core Games Ltd. Co.
Inspired by Davidii's Heroes!, Dark Souls 3, Monster Hunter & Warframe.

Many things to come.

games.name: DesertStorm [EXTRACTION]
games.desc:
Desertstorm is a challenging Extraction FPS experience built to push your PvP and PvE skills to their limits...

*THIS EXPERIENCE IS IN ALPHA, EXPECT RESTARTS, UNFINISHED CONTENT AND GAME BREAKING BUGS*

Dying is part of the learning progress.
No matter how strong you are, expect it to happen often.

- Fight against other players or defeat hardcore bosses and become the richest
- Extract with as much gear as possible, and resell everything to traders
- Earn reputation from multiple traders by completing tasks

- This game is inspired by numerous hardcore games like Escape From Tarkov, Rust, DayZ...

** PRIVATE SERVERS HAVE A SEPARATE SAVES FROM PUBLIC SERVERS **

- Check our links for leaks, update logs, and upcoming content
